result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the 'Popular right now' list has an inconsistent/low-contrast favorite button on the second card and a suspicious '-100%' discount badge. A minor image-styling inconsistency also appears in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The second promoted restaurant card shows a '-100%' discount badge, implying the order is entirely free. This is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g. a raw or miscalculated discount value) rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering and cap/format them sensibly (e.g. '-50%' or 'Free item'); suppress badges outside a plausible range.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark/near-black circular background with a white outline heart, while the identical button on the card above uses a white circle with a dark outline. The inconsistent treatment makes the second heart hard to see against the dark image and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button style (e.g. semi-transparent white circle with dark icon) across all restaurant cards, ensuring sufficient contrast over any image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a light gray background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, so the row looks visually uneven and the white duration pill on it has weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent background/overlay gradient) and ensure the duration pill has a contrasting background on light images.
